Vendored for reproducibility: the adapted skills under backend/skills/builtin/ are generated from these
sources by scripts/import_upstream_skills.py, and each generated SKILL.md cites its upstream path.

mattpocock/skills   MIT (LICENSE beside this file)   https://github.com/mattpocock/skills
langchain-skills    MIT (LICENSE beside this file)   https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain-skills

Nothing here is loaded by the app; it exists so a regeneration is a diff, not a re-download.
